Stamped here so the LATEST wrap carries a stamp of its own and no older session's line is graded in its place.

> **POST-MORTEM #266 — measured, not narrated.** ⚙ **TWO OBJECTS, REPORTED SEPARATELY, NEVER SUMMED OR CONVERTED** [[measure-dont-convert-units]]: **FILL** is resident context (`message.usage`); **THROUGHPUT** is the cumulative log (`_checkin.py`'s headline). **FILL: 304,364 real DECLARED by the conductor at the wrap call · 311,775 real measured first-hand at this seat over 137 turns** — two readings of a moving number, both stand, neither is the other. ⛔★ **THIS IS A BREACH AND IT IS RECORDED AS ONE: 124,364 OVER the `s260-D2` delegated stop line of 180,000 and 104,364 OVER the 200,000 working ceiling** at the declared reading; 131,775 over the stop line at the later one. ★ **CAUSE, MEASURED NOT GUESSED: 131 turns at roughly 2K each — a visual-iteration loop (render, look, adjust) whose per-turn cost is small enough that no single turn ever looked like the moment to stop.** ⇒ **a loop of cheap turns hides a breach from the instrument built to catch an expensive one**, and check-in-at-every-seam did not fail; the loop never presented a seam. ⛔ **BOOT 70,442 real, MEASURED at this seat — 442 OVER the 70,000 shrink-only literal and the SECOND CONSECUTIVE BREACH** after #265's 70,260. **THROUGHPUT: 3,898,415 cl100k-estimate** (`gauge.count`, ONE call — NOT comparable to FILL).

> **wrap-handover: brief-cut 304,364 real (conductor, DECLARED in the wrap brief) · sub-cut 311,775 real (first-hand `knowledge/_checkin.py` at this seat, 137 turns) · delta 7,411 real · replay unobservable (conductor-side, post-wrap)**

> **⛔ NO `subs` LINE IS WRITTEN AT THIS BLOCK, AND THE REASON IS PARTIAL FIGURES RATHER THAN NO FIGURES.** Measured Agent `usage`, REAL Claude tokens and **QUOTA, never window FILL**: lane **K 127,207**, lane **V 175,198**. ⛔ **Lanes T and R were NOT captured by the conductor, and this wrap seat's own spend is unreadable from inside itself.** A total across two measured and two unknown lanes would be **a number pretending to be a measurement**; the contract makes an absent line legal and a wrong figure not, and an UNKNOWN is never defaulted [[feedback-measuring-tool-must-not-guess]]. The two measured figures are written here in prose so they are not lost with the window — deliberately NOT on a `subs`-shaped line, which would parse as a session total.
